author: Artist not identified / District Museum in Toruń
en: Anonymous portrait of Nicolaus Copernicus, circa 1580, from the Town Hall collection in Toruń. Painted after his death in 1543, it is a later representation, not a reliably documented portrait made during his lifetime.
zh: 托伦市政厅馆藏的尼古拉·哥白尼肖像，作者未详，约绘于 1580 年。画作晚于他于 1543 年去世的时间，属于后世形象，并非有可靠记录的生前肖像。
